logTypes.name: Zeek
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(data.timestamp), timestamp = todatetime(data.timestamp), message = data.message | project TimeGenerated, timestamp, message

logTypes.name: Mail
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(data.timestamp), timestamp = todatetime(data.timestamp), message = data.message | project TimeGenerated, timestamp, message

logTypes.name: Ztna
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(data.timestamp), authority_name = tostring(data.authority_name), message = tostring(data.message), message_type = tostring(data.message_type), object_name = tostring(data.object_name), object_name_portal = tostring(data.object_name_portal), remote_address = tostring(data.remote_address), status = tostring(data.status), subject_name = tostring(data.subject_name), timestamp = tostring(data.timestamp), uuid = tostring(data.uuid), ztna_tenant = tostring(data.ztna_tenant), ztna_upstream = tostring(data.ztna_upstream), action = tostring(data.action), result = tostring(data.result) | project TimeGenerated, authority_name, message, message_type, object_name, object_name_portal, remote_address, status, subject_name, timestamp, uuid, ztna_tenant, ztna_upstream, action, result

logTypes.name: Firewall
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = datetime_add('second', toint(data.timestamp), datetime(1970-01-01)), action = tostring(data.action), host_name = tostring(data.host_name), iface_in = tostring(data.iface_in), iface_out = tostring(data.iface_out), ip_dst = tostring(data.ip_dst), ip_src = tostring(data.ip_src), port_dst = toint(data.port_dst), port_src = toint(data.port_src), timestamp = toint(data.timestamp), zone_dst = tostring(data.zone_dst), zone_src = tostring(data.zone_src) | project TimeGenerated, action, host_name, iface_in, iface_out, ip_dst, ip_src, port_dst, port_src, timestamp, zone_dst, zone_src

logTypes.name: Authentication
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(data.event_time), login = tostring(data.login), remoteAddress = data.remoteAddress, result = tostring(data.result), event_time = todatetime(data.event_time), error = tostring(data.error) | project TimeGenerated, login, remoteAddress, result, event_time, error

logTypes.name: Proxy
logTypes.transformKql: source | extend data = parse_json(RawData) | extend TimeGenerated = datetime_add('second', tolong(data.timestamp), datetime(1970-01-01)), casb_application = tostring(data.casb_application), casb_category = tostring(data.casb_category), casb_operation = tostring(data.casb_operation), casb_risk_score = tostring(data.casb_risk_score), client_ip = tostring(data.client_ip), client_request_size = tostring(data.client_request_size), client_response_size = tostring(data.client_response_size), client_response_status = tostring(data.client_response_status), content_type = tostring(data.content_type), duration = tostring(data.duration), error_details = tostring(data.error_details), http_method = tostring(data.http_method), server_ip = tostring(data.server_ip), server_response_size = tostring(data.server_response_size), time_dns = tostring(data.time_dns), time_icap = tostring(data.time_icap), time_server = tostring(data.time_server), timestamp = toreal(data.timestamp), tls_cert_errors = tostring(data.tls_cert_errors), tls_client_cipher = tostring(data.tls_client_cipher), tls_client_max_version = tostring(data.tls_client_max_version), tls_client_version = tostring(data.tls_client_version), tls_server_cipher = tostring(data.tls_server_cipher), tls_server_max_version = tostring(data.tls_server_max_version), tls_server_version = tostring(data.tls_server_version), url = tostring(data.url), url_filter_action = tostring(data.url_filter_action), url_filter_categories = tostring(data.url_filter_categories), url_filter_result = tostring(data.url_filter_result), user_agent = tostring(data.user_agent), user_id = tostring(data.user_id), host_id = tostring(data.host_id), referer = tostring(data.referer) | project TimeGenerated, casb_application, casb_category, casb_operation, casb_risk_score, client_ip, client_request_size, client_response_size, client_response_status, content_type, duration, error_details, http_method, server_ip, server_response_size, time_dns, time_icap, time_server, timestamp, tls_cert_errors, tls_client_cipher, tls_client_max_version, tls_client_version, tls_server_cipher, tls_server_max_version, tls_server_version, url, url_filter_action, url_filter_categories, url_filter_result, user_agent, user_id, host_id, referer

variables.proxyReceiverConf:
[if(parameters('secureWebGateway'), '  kafka/proxy:
    brokers:
      - ${LOGS_API_ENDPOINT}
    protocol_version: "1.0.0"
    auth:
      sasl:
        mechanism: PLAIN
        username: $$ConnectionString
        password: ${LOGS_API_STRING};EntityPath=proxy
    tls:
      insecure: false
    logs:
      topics:
        - proxy
      encoding: json
    group_id: $$Default
    initial_offset: earliest
    client_id: sentinel-connector-proxy
    autocommit:
      enable: false
    message_marking:
      after: true
', '')]

secrets.name: protocols
secrets.value:
ip      0       IP      # internet protocol
icmp    1       ICMP    # internet control message protocol
tcp     6       TCP     # transmission control protocol
udp     17      UDP     # user datagram protocol
